prompt_en: Create a complex nocturnal botanical-forensics scene in a moonlit orchid conservatory. An unmistakably adult forensic botanist reconstructs a luminous pollen-transfer path, aligning clear measurement panels between rare blooms while numbered evidence dishes and a macro camera document the trace. Frame a waist-up environmental portrait, frontal with only a slight turn, so hairline temples cheek edges jawlines and chin remain visible. Her oval face contour is clear: the face is moderately longer than wide; the zygomatic region is subtly widest while the forehead and jaw are somewhat narrower; the jaw narrows smoothly into a rounded chin without an abrupt angular corner. A neutral expression and controlled perspective preserve the actual contour while soft light and restrained makeup clarify it. She sweeps her hair behind both temples as one hand places a panel. Greenhouse moonlight and a diffused field lamp share one gentle facial modeling direction. Render photorealistically, with orchid glass reflections, fine pollen glow, accurate botanical textures, and dimensional background depth. Use the supplied portrait as an appearance reference for general adult appearance; the specified oval contour governs.
negative_en: over-processed retouching, illustration look, inaccurate reflections, excessive HDR, cartoon style, 3D render look, warped product geometry, fake-looking background, low resolution
